items.note: An earlier, interrupted attempt had already made Bump on a recalled line go recalled → preparing → bumped, made Reject return a clear 409 PAID_AT_TILL, and hidden Reject on paid orders in the admin expo. Those all work. This pass closes the parts that were still open, all on the server, so the tablet works without a tablet code change. (1) Held lines no longer reach a Bump-only screen. GET /expo/station/:id/queue only lists held lines, and the recipe steps of held dishes, when called with ?states=all. The admin /kds and /kds/<station> pages now send ?states=all; the tablet's plain call no longer gets paused work. Recalled lines stay on the tablet, and its Bump clears them. (2) A Bump on a held line is now refused with 409 ITEM_ON_HOLD (resume it first) instead of going straight through the hold. The admin already resumes before bumping. The step-bump route resumes a held item itself once all of its steps are done, so it can't throw partway through. (3) The tablet's READY on a paid till sale now works. PATCH /orders/:id/status {status:'ready'} on a till sale that is already paid calls the new bumpPaidTillSale (orders/service.ts), which bumps each fired line through updateItemStatus. The order stays 'completed', expo moves it to its ready column, and the hand-off returns 200. Nothing is bumped if a line is held (ITEM_ON_HOLD) or a course hasn't been fired (ITEMS_NOT_FIRED). Any other status on a paid till sale still returns PAID_AT_TILL. The lookup is company-scoped first, so company B gets a 404. Still open, in the tablet code: remakes show no REMAKE label.

Already in the working tree, and verified. IngestOrderDTO = OrderDTO & { tip_cents?: number }. ingestOrder validates it as a whole number from 0 up to payment.amountCents (otherwise 422 INVALID_TIP) and writes Order.tipCents in the same insert as the total. With no tip_cents it writes 0, so existing callers are unaffected. Tested in auditOrdersFollowup F1. The storefront still sets the tip in a second write (see needsOtherFiles).

Already in the working tree, and verified. frontend/admin/src/app/expo/page.tsx shows a Paid badge on paid till orders in all three columns (awaitingFire, inProgress, ready) and hides Reject when `paid` is set.

lib/orderStateMachine.ts (comments only): ready → preparing is left out of ORDER_TRANSITIONS on purpose. A recall moves the order back through reopenOrderForRemake() in orders/service.ts, a conditional update outside transitionOrder, so no customer message or webhook is sent again. Also updated the item-table comment: a recalled line is walked through preparing, a held line is refused until resumed.

tests: Ran 11 files twice on DB servd_test_fix2_orders with Redis db 26: auditOrdersFollowup, auditOrdersKitchen, auditOrdersIngest, auditOrdersRefund, customerRollups, groupOrderSubmit, orderLifecycle, orders, ordersReconcile, auditKitchen, auditKitchenStations. All 108 tests passed on both runs. New and updated R4 tests, each checking company B: a held line is left out of the plain station queue and shown as HELD with ?states=all (company B sees nothing); a Bump on a held line returns 409 ITEM_ON_HOLD and the line stays held; after Resume it is back on the queue and Bump works; a recalled remake stays on the plain queue and bumps; Reject on a paid till sale returns PAID_AT_TILL (404 for company B); READY on a paid till sale returns 404 for company B with nothing bumped, 409 ITEM_ON_HOLD while a line is held with nothing bumped, then 200 with every line bumped, the order still 'completed', expo showing it in ready and the hand-off returning 200; READY with a course not fired returns ITEMS_NOT_FIRED; any other status returns PAID_AT_TILL. The R7 test was flaky: the background re-timing of course 1 could overwrite the test's own 'old fire time'. The test now waits for it to finish. `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` is clean in backend and in frontend/admin.

prodNotes: No schema change and no data migration. Deploy the API and admin images together: the admin KDS now asks for ?states=all. If the new API goes out with the old admin, the admin KDS stops showing held lines (they come back when resumed) and Bump on a held line returns ITEM_ON_HOLD. If the new admin goes out with the old API, the extra query parameter is ignored. Behaviour change staff will notice: a held line no longer appears on station tablets; a manager resumes it on the admin KDS (Resume) and it reappears. A Bump on a held line is refused until it is resumed. On a till sale that is already paid, the tablet's READY now bumps every fired line in one tap. The order stays completed, and nothing is posted to the ledger, invoiced or messaged to the customer again.
